subject: Discovery recap + ask: usage profile & preliminary invoice sketch
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@brightleaf.ai>, Elena Soto <elena.soto@brightleaf.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 27 Nov 2027 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery recap + ask: usage profile & preliminary invoice sketch

Hi Tom / Elena — great conversation today, thanks for taking the time. Below is a short recap of what we heard during the call and a few asks so we can finalize the preliminary invoice sketch I promised. I attached the quick model (brightleaf_token_model_v1.xlsx) and a one-page invoice sketch (redwood_invoice_sketch.pdf).

Recap (from our discovery):
- Primary product area: in-app summarization + feature-extraction for enterprise documents (legal / contracts).
- Expected pilot cohort: ~50 power users initially, expanding to ~1,200 MAUs at scale.
- Request profile: 2–3 API calls per user per day during pilot; average request length ~1,200 prompt tokens + average 600 generated tokens per call (includes context).
- Peak concurrency expectation: up to 40 concurrent requests during business hours for pilot, 400+ at scale.
- Data residency: US-only (no EU processing).

Our immediate asks to tighten the model: 
1) Confirm a realistic monthly token envelope for pilot and year-1 scale. If it helps, list tokens per month or avg calls/day.
2) Confirm whether you anticipate long-running contexts (multi-turn sessions with KV cache) vs single-shot calls — this affects token delta.
3) Any internal budget guardrails for model spend (e.g., target $/1M tokens or monthly cap)? You mentioned a target earlier; please re-state if possible.

Quick assumptions I used in the attached model to produce the draft invoice:
- Pilot: 50 users, 2.5 calls/day, 1,800 tokens/call (prompt+gen) => ~6.8M tokens/mo.
- Scale (year 1): 1,200 MAUs, 2 calls/day, 1,800 tokens/call => ~129.6M tokens/mo.
- Unit price scenarios shown: $1,200 / 1M tokens (hosted), $700 / 1M tokens (reserved/dedicated), and a blended discount path for committed volumes.

If you can confirm the pilot tokens and your target $/1M tokens, I can produce: (a) a one-page invoice with line items (model, reserved capacity delta, burst buffer), (b) a sensitivity tab for token volumes, and (c) a reserved-capacity proposal with commitment tiers.

Proposed next steps:
- You confirm token counts and budget threshold (reply here).
- I turn around a short invoice estimate + a 3-scenario sensitivity spreadsheet by EOD Monday.
- If that looks good, schedule a 30-min follow-up demo to walk finance and infra folks through the cost model.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Subject: Re: Discovery recap + ask: usage profile & preliminary invoice sketch

Marissa — thanks for the recap and for the attachments. Helpful. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Pilot tokens: we ran a quick pass with our internal telemetry and estimate ~5–8M tokens/mo depending on usage. So your pilot estimate of ~6.8M sits in the middle.
2) Scale profile: our product roadmap expects 700–1,500 MAUs by month 12. To be conservative, model 1,000 MAUs for year-1 estimates.
3) Calls per user: most users will do 1–3 calls per day; our ops team expects average closer to 1.8 during year-1.
4) Multi-turn: initially single-shot (no long-lived KV per user). We'll evaluate session caching in Q2 2028.
5) Budget target: leadership approved a target of ~$650 per 1M tokens (hosted equivalent) as a stretch goal for Year 1. If committed reserved pricing reduces that to ~$400 / 1M tokens that would be ideal.

Can you produce three scenarios: Pilot (5–8M tokens), Conservative Year-1 (60M tokens), Aggressive Year-1 (130M tokens) with line items showing: model compute cost, caching/bandwidth, reserved pool premium (if applicable), and expected monthly invoice?

Also please add a short column with "recommended engagement" (hosted vs dedicated vs private) given each scenario.

One more ask: can you include a short amortized per-feature cost (e.g., cost per monthly active user) so our PM can map token spend back to product pricing?

Thanks — Tom
Tom Reynolds
Head of Product, Brightleaf AI
Tom.Reynolds@brightleaf.ai | +1 (617) 555-0144

I've attached a CSV with the quick calc (pilot_pricing_calc.csv) — this is rough; please tighten the assumptions and produce:
- A one-page invoice estimate for each scenario (line items + monthly total).
- A short guidance note on recommended engagement (hosted vs dedicated vs private) and what discounts/SLAs apply.
- A per-MAU amortized line that shows cost at the MAU levels they requested.

Quick numbers I threw into the CSV for context (very rough):
- Pilot: 6.8M tokens/mo => hosted unit shown at $1,200/1M => $8,160/mo. Dedicated sketch at $700/1M => $4,760/mo.
- Conservative Y1: 60M tokens/mo => hosted $1,200/1M => $72,000/mo. Dedicated $700/1M => $42,000/mo.
- Aggressive Y1: 130M tokens/mo => hosted $1,200/1M => $156,000/mo. Dedicated $700/1M => $91,000/mo.

Notes: these hosted prices are placeholder list; we should produce a realistic blended offering that meets their ~$650/1M target for hosted or show how reserved commits reduce to ~$400/1M.

Can you take this and: (a) tighten compute/infra cost line items (GPU hours equivalent, caching savings assumption), (b) produce a short proposed commitment ladder to get to their $400/1M reserved target, and (c) return the results as a single PDF + spreadsheet by EOD Tuesday?

Thanks — Marissa

Tom / Elena — thanks, and looping Karthik + Rachel who produced the attached materials. Please find:
- redwood_invoice_sketch.pdf (one-pager with line items per scenario)
- brightleaf_token_model_v1.xlsx (sensitivity tabs + per-MAU amortization)
- pilot_pricing_calc.csv (detailed cost line items)

Executive summary of the materials attached: 
- Pilot (5–8M tokens/mo): recommended: hosted with a small burst buffer. Estimated monthly cost range: $5,200 — $9,600 depending on whether you take a 3-month commit. Per-MAU (50 power users): ~$104 — $192 / MAU.
- Conservative Y1 (60M tokens/mo): recommended: dedicated node pool (medium commitment). Blended unit price: ~$650 / 1M tokens (we can hit this with a 6–12 month commit + small autoscale buffer). Estimated monthly invoice: ~$39,000. Per-MAU (1,000 MAUs assumed): ~$39 / MAU.
- Aggressive Y1 (130M tokens/mo): recommended: dedicated + reserved capacity with a burst contract. Blended unit price: ~$415 / 1M tokens at a 12‑month  commit; estimated monthly invoice: ~$53,950. Per-MAU (1,500 MAUs assumed): ~$36 / MAU.

Key levers we used in the model:
- Batching and prefix caching assumptions reduce tokenized compute by ~18% at scale (sensitivity in the spreadsheet).
- Reserved capacity reduces the model compute unit to the dedicated-equivalent price shown; further opt-in quantization and lower-cost model variants can reduce blended cost further.
- Networking and storage add a small fixed monthly surcharge (listed as "platform & transfer" in the invoice sketch).

Attachments are editable; I've left a small comments column so you can drop in your PM's MAU plan and we will recompute live.

Proposed next steps:
1) Quick 30-min cost walk-through with Brightleaf finance & infra — please suggest two time slots this week.
2) If the conservative scenario looks aligned, we can draft a 6-month dedicated proposal (term sheet + SLA) for internal review.
3) If you need a deeper run-rate forecast for Y2, we can schedule a half-day workshop to map usage to pricing levers.

I'll also open a HubSpot deal note (BR-2027-1107) with these artifacts.

Best,
